name: media.frames
title: Media frames
summary: Grab still frames from a video at given times, as PNG or JPEG, optionally scaled to a width, to eyeball or compare an encode.
description: Seeks to each time and writes one image per timestamp using ffmpeg. Use it to check an encode, a transition or a frame-accurate edit. The output names carry the requested time to three decimals.

video.description: Video file to grab frames from: a workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>.

times.description: Timestamps in seconds (>= 0); one output image is written per entry.

format.description: Image format: png (lossless) or jpeg. JPEG output uses the .jpg extension.

width.description: Optional output width in pixels; the height follows the source aspect ratio (scale=W:-2). Omit to keep the source size.
